# Vendored upstream

`custom_components/beatify/` is [mholzi/beatify](https://github.com/mholzi/beatify)
at the tag recorded in `../VERSION.upstream`, **byte-identical and unmodified**.

Do not edit, lint or format anything in this directory. The entire point of this
project is that upstream stays untouched, so a new release can be dropped in by
replacing this tree. `../tools/check_ha_surface.py` verifies that a candidate
release still fits the shim before it is adopted.

Upstream is MIT-licensed; its licence is preserved here as `LICENSE.upstream`.
